warnings.message: Archive reason for Gilligan has no core Member field and is in extensions.org.thepluralbridge.archived_reason.
Account name and email have no core System field and are in extensions.org.thepluralbridge.account.
Account permission read was not mapped to a role or visibility. It is in extensions.org.thepluralbridge.account.permission.
Friends and privacy buckets stay in extensions.org.thepluralbridge because the captured sharing module has no record definition. The sharing module is not declared.
